turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of a class and nobody called me, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
You didn't answer my question. Who decided, and on what basis?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale, not evidence. Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone does not establish a concern, and I have the vendor's guide in my bag saying the same thing. So what else do you have, and was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.

"Quite reliable." Okay. Fourteen of these detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable, so I'll ask a third time: what else do you have, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
So I had to give him a zero.

"Had to." So you decided first and asked questions later, which your own procedure says you don't get to do. Withdraw the zero and put it in writing, or I'm in the principal's office before I leave this building.
I hope you understand my position.

Your position is a percentage from a piece of software and a zero entered without a phone call to me. That's not a position, Hale, that's a mistake. Is there a document with dates on it tied to Owen's work, yes or no?
